description: Stamp a diagonal text watermark on pages of a PDF (default: centered, 45 degrees, grey, 15% opacity). Text is upright and centered for any page size or existing page rotation. Standard Helvetica only: characters outside WinAnsi (e.g. CJK, emoji) fail with unsupported_characters. Use this for DRAFT / CONFIDENTIAL stamps; use pdf_page_numbers for numbering. Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

pages.description: 1-based page spec such as "1-3,5"; default all pages

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise as the viewer sees it, default 45

name: pdf_watermark

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Add text watermark to PDF
